Strict monotonicity of G(t) and the algebraic rate-ratio identity yield an exact iff anisotropy interval with both boundaries. Independent exact-event trajectory checks corroborate but are not treated as proof.

value.rationale: The asymptotic fluctuation rate is a motivated nonequilibrium thermodynamic observable distinct from mean entropy production; it quantifies reliability of long-time active energy transfer. A global iff switching-rate window for a unique confinement-induced relative-noise maximum, speed- and temperature-independent, is a genuine structural phase classification and an experimentally testable prediction, not an arbitrary parameter slice or routine first-moment recomputation.
